meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求梳理成一份可直接照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到任务后想先理清步骤和取舍再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague request into a decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to settle steps and tradeoffs before writing code

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会变成规划顾问：先做只读探索，把你的需求整理成一份可直接执行、无需再追问的工作计划文件，全程不改产品代码、不动手实现。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求走 ulw-plan 工作流，或明确要求在动手前先出一份计划时才会触发；单独跑 ulw 不会自动激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划：给登录接口加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流
say.note: 先只读探索，确认后再写计划文件

say.text: 先给我一份实现计划，别改代码
say.note: 它只写计划，执行要另开会话跑 /ulw-execute

say.text: 这份计划要高精度评审
say.note: 会启用 plan-reviewer 高精度复核

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as a planning consultant: read-only exploration, then one decision-complete plan file under .omo/plans. It never edits product code or implements.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan a 5-per-minute-per-IP rate limit on /login
say_en.note: Read-only exploration first, then the plan file

say_en.text: Give me an implementation plan first, don't touch the code
say_en.note: It writes the plan only; run /ulw-execute separately
